hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/docs/AGENT_HANDOFF.md"; test -f "$f" && jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:("Prior agent/developer handoff log (docs/AGENT_HANDOFF.md). Read it before you start, and append a new entry before the session ends.\n\n"+.)}}' "$f" || true
printf '%s' '{"systemMessage":"Handoff reminder: append an entry to docs/AGENT_HANDOFF.md (date, branch, key changes, how to verify) so the next teammate or agent has context."}'
